messages:
maria: Heads up — we've seen ~20 customer errors this morning where requests that should've been routed to v2 fell back to v1 and then hit quota checks. Root cause unclear. Anyone on call?

liam: Looking. Client header is `x-redwood-api-version: 2` but routing logs show mismatch; affinity token missing. Pulling logs now.

sam: Runtime shows fallthrough because model variant `gpt-small-q4` wasn't marked compatible for v2 in the routing table. Fallback rule kicked in to v1. Working on a patch.

maria: Are we sure fallback should trigger quota checks for v1? That breaks customers expecting v2 quota buckets.

anya: From product — customers expect version pinning to preserve billing semantics. If we silently route to v1, we should keep v2 quota/billing. Console UX should warn when that happens.

liam: Right now our routing only preserves quota when `route_preserve_quota=true` is set. Policy default is false. That explains the unexpected charges.

nora: Telemetry note: we can surface a combined signal: `routing.fallback.reason` + `quota.bucket_changed`. Seen 74 occurrences in the last 6h.

maria: Can we flip default to preserve quota for canary weeks? What are perf/cost impacts?

sam: Preserving quota means we maintain v2 token accounting but execute on v1 runtime. Slightly more bookkeeping — latency impact negligible but cost gets attributed to v2. Implementation ~2-3 PRs (routing, billing bridge, tests).

liam: Proposed immediate mitigation: don't trigger fallback to v1 when requests explicitly specify version header and compat check fails. Instead return 409 with a helpful error message (fail-fast).

anya: Prefer fail-fast for now — less surprise for users. We can add a console banner and an opt-in toggle for `preserve_quota` during rollout.

maria: Agreed. Action items: (1) liam to add 409 for explicit-version fallthrough; (2) sam to add quick telemetry tag; (3) anya to draft console banner copy. Owners?

liam: I'll open PR in ~30m — will include unit tests for header + token combos and a changelog note.

sam: I'll add a TOP-level metric and create a dashboard skeleton: `v2.routing.fallback.count`, `v2.quota.preserved.count`, and a small table for affected customers.

nora: Will add an alert when fallback ratio > 0.5% over 15m and attach the example request IDs for investigation.

devops-bot: Deploy scheduled by liam at 2026-03-20T14:40Z — rolling, canary 5%.

maria: Thanks. Keep updates here. Also add a short note to the status page if we decide to fail-fast so support has a canonical response. :thumbsup:
